events.verdict: Kessler (UTA) legally contests Haliburton's (IND) jump shot, making incidental "high-five" following his release.
Siakam (IND) briefly grasps Collins' (UTA) side before correcting.
Siakam (IND) moves alongside of George's (UTA) path to the basket and the body contact during his driving shot attempt is marginal.
Collins (UTA) makes contact with the ball after it exits the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Bryant (IND) establishes himself in Clarkson's (UTA) path and does not deliver contact.
Clarkson (UTA) firms up in his defensive position and absorbs the contact with Siakam (IND).
Markkanen (UTA) and Nesmith (IND) each place their forearms against the opposing player and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Nesmith (IND) is in a legal guarding position when Clarkson (UTA) loses control of the ball.
Collins (UTA) establishes himself in a screening position in Haliburton's (IND) path and does not deliver contact during the pick.
Haliburton (IND) legally contests George's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Collins (UTA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Possession should have been awarded to Indiana instead of Utah.
Nesmith (IND) contests Markkanen's (UTA) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Collins (UTA) clamps and holds Siakam's (IND) arm, affecting his ability to get to the rebound.
Bryant (IND) gets his hand on the ball while Kessler (UTA) has possession and any contact prior to the whistled held ball is incidental.
Nesmith (IND) makes contact to Markkanen's (UTA) arm and affects his shot attempt.
Markkanen (UTA) crosses the plane of the free throw line prior to the ball making contact with the rim.
George (UTA) commits a take foul on Nesmith (IND).
George (UTA) briefly grasps Haliburton's (IND) arm and immediately releases.

Siakam (IND) obtains a position in front of George (UTA), who briefly grasps his arm. George falls to the floor when he releases, but he is not dislodged from his position as a result of any contact initiated by Siakam.
Toppin (IND) and Markkanen (UTA) briefly engage and disengage during the throw-in.
Siakam (IND) legally contests George's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Clarkson (UTA) and Toppin (IND) engage during the pass and the ensuing contact between the two players is incidental.
Siakam (IND) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from George's (UTA) possession.
